description: Registry of intentional methodology variants and documented divergences

variants.title: T### Series ID Convention
variants.description: AS2 uses T### IDs (e.g., T501, T601) instead of the Anu Suite standard S### pattern. The T prefix encodes chapter-table structure: first digit = chapter number, following digits = table sequence within chapter.
variants.rationale: Self-documenting IDs for anyone familiar with Shaikh & Tonak (1994) table numbering
variants.impact: All scripts, catalogs, DPRs, registry entries use T### throughout

variants.title: Total K Instead of Productive K*
variants.description: Marxian profit rate r* = S*/(C*+V*) uses total private fixed assets K from BEA Fixed Assets Table 4.1, instead of productive sector capital K* restricted via IO classification.
variants.rationale: IO-based sector classification (Chapter 4) required for K* restriction; not yet available (Wave 2)
variants.impact: T513, T514 profit rate levels are lower than book values; trend direction preserved
variants.resolution: Wave 2 IO framework will enable K* restriction

variants.title: Constant VA*/W = 1.238
variants.description: Extension period uses approximately constant VA*/W ratio (1.238) instead of year-varying ec_u/ec_p ratio from BLS CES data. Partially resolved: code now supports year-varying input.
variants.rationale: Full resolution requires BLS industry-level compensation data unavailable for 1990-1997 (SIC-era gap)
variants.impact: T504, T505, T506, T512 extension values carry small systematic error at inter-benchmark years
